title.narrative: International and Security Affairs Centre (ISAC) - Project in Serbia 2016
International and Security Affairs Centre (ISAC) - Projekt i Serbien 2016

description.narrative: Providing support to Serbia's Accession Negotiations in Chapters 30 and 31. The overall purpose of the project is to promote the development of democracy, rule of law and human rights in Serbia by supporting Serbia’s efforts to become a member of the EU. The project facilitates the wide acceptance of obligations stemming from Serbia's EU accession negotiations in Chapter 31 and provides support to the efforts of Serbia's Chief Negotiator.
